Multiple Indian Companies Launch Initial Public Offerings

Several Indian companies have recently filed or opened their Initial Public Offerings (IPOs), seeking to raise capital from the public markets. These include SBI Funds Management, Laser Power & Infra, IC Electricals, Kusumgar, and Cult.fit. The offerings range in size and target valuation, with some already seeing significant investor interest and subscription levels.
